title: Construction Truck Cab Mounts by Cab Type
metaTitle: Construction Truck Cab Phone Mount Guide by Cab Type | iBOLT
metaDescription: Regular cab, crew cab, service body, dump truck, or van: find the right construction truck cab phone mount for your specific setup with this practical
excerpt: Not every work cab mounts the same way. This guide breaks down phone and tablet mounting by cab type so contractors, fleet managers, and field crews can pick the right setup the first time.

spec.title: Construction Truck Cab Mounts by Cab Type
spec.audience: contractors, fleet managers, installers, foremen, and field service crews
spec.problem: A regular pickup cab, crew cab, service body, dump truck, and van cab all create different mounting problems for phones, tablets, radios, GPS units, and charging cables.
spec.angle: Compare cab types first, then explain which mounting approach fits each one: vehicle-specific dash mounts, cup-holder mounts, wedge mounts, drill-base AMPS mounts, suction mounts, and rail clamps.
spec.comparisonFrame: Discuss product classes fairly. ProClip-style vehicle-specific mounts are good for clean no-drill installs in one model, but are less flexible for mixed fleets. RAM-style ball systems are good for modular heavy-duty builds, but can be overbuilt for a simple phone-only cab. Bulletpoint-style dash rails are strong for specific truck and Jeep interiors, but are model-specific. iBOLT fits mixed work fleets when AMPS compatibility, quick replacement parts, cup-holder/wedge placement, and drill-base options matter.

products.title: iBOLT Phone Dock'n Lock IncrediBOLT™ AMPS w/ 4.25" Arm Locking Drill Base Mount for Smartphones
products.description: The Dock'n Lock IncrediBOLT™ AMPS is a heavy-duty locking phone mount featuring a 4.25-inch double socket arm with a center rotation point. This multi-angle drill base pedestal mounting solution is made out of composite material and features 2 Metal AMPS pattern bases. It is designed to be installed directly on a wall, table, cart, desk, in a vehicle, or on any flat surface allowing you to use your device where you need it most.

products.title: iBOLT™ xProDock™ Bizmount™ Console- Phone Cup Holder Mount
products.description: The xProDock Bizmount™ Console with an expandable cup holder base is a heavy-duty smartphone mount designed for trucks, fleet vehicles, commercial drivers, and industrial use. Its adjustable base fits securely into cup holders from 2.5" to 3.5" diameter, providing a stable and vibration-resistant phone mounting solution. Featuring dual ball joints for 360-degree rotation and tilt, this truck phone mount allows for customizable, ergonomic viewing angles on the road. Compatible with most smartphones and protective cases, the spring-loaded top latch accommodates devices 2.59" to 3.7" wide. This rugged cup holder phone mount kit includes everything needed for quick, tool-free installation, making it ideal for Electronic Logging Device (ELD) compliance, fleet management, and hands-free smartphone use during long hauls.

products.title: iBOLT™ xProDock™ Bizmount™ Wedge
products.description: The xProDock Bizmount™ Seat Wedge Mount is a heavy-duty smartphone mounting solution designed for rugged trucking, fleet, and industrial environments. This tool-free mount slides securely between the passenger seat and center console, providing stable front-seat viewing or convenient back-seat entertainment without any drilling or adhesives. Built to resist vibration and movement on rough roads, the sturdy wedge base keeps your smartphone firmly in place. Compatible with most smartphones-including those in protective cases-the spring-loaded top latch adjusts to fit devices from 2.59" (66mm) to 3.7" (94mm) wide with unlimited height. The kit features a 3.75" pedestal with dual 1-inch (25mm) ball joints compatible with all industry-standard AMPS mounting arms and adapters.
